backend/main.mo: Motoko backend defining stories, comments, reviews, user profiles, access control, and submission/publishing logic with admin‑restricted operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requests to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of various frontend files across the app.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining canister roles, usage of frontend canister ID, and basic deployment workflow notes.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS variables and theme definitions for light and dark modes using OKLCH color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React app, favicon assets, and root mounting element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main router configuration defining all routes including login and redirecting /my-submissions to the login page.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component showing access‑denied messaging with login prompts, principal display, and navigation actions.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders the site header with navigation links, identity checks, and conditional admin access. Uses router navigation and Internet Identity state to display appropriate options.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the main page layout with header, footer, and content slot. Includes footer links and contact information.
Form for submitting comments to a story, handling user input and posting via useAddComment. Shows loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays a list of comments for a story with relative timestamps and loading skeletons. Shows a placeholder when no comments exist.
frontend/src/components/CommentThreadDis: Fetches all discussions and displays comments for a specific story. Includes loading skeletons and empty-state messaging.
frontend/src/components/FeedDiagnosticsP: Shows canister diagnostic info with copy buttons and optional URLs. Helps users troubleshoot by exposing deployment identifiers.
frontend/src/components/ReviewComposer.t: Form for submitting reviews with rating stars, optional name, and comment. Handles review submission and pending states.
frontend/src/components/ReviewThread.tsx: Displays reviews for a story with rating stars and timestamps. Includes loading skeletons and an empty-review placeholder.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides admin-only queries and mutations for checking admin status, managing pending stories, and publishing or deleting articles.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAvailabilit: Checks backend heartbeat status to determine canister availability with minimal caching and explicit enabling.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: Fetches all discussions and adds reviews, invalidating discussion queries on updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity state, login, logout, and status tracking via context.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Handles fetching and updating published stories, submissions, comments, and related mutations with retry logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based light and dark themes, typography, focus styles, and global UI variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an About page with author information, platform purpose, and contact details.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Admin interface for reviewing pending stories, creating articles, and managing published content with publish/delete actions.
frontend/src/pages/ArticleDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single published article with metadata and supports viewing and adding comments.
frontend/src/pages/ArticlesPage.tsx: Lists all published articles with loading and error states and navigation to individual article pages.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Static contact page showing author info, email, social links, and book details.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Combines comment and review discussions by topic, offering topic selection and threaded displays.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Homepage-style feed showing stories with robust backend error handling and diagnostics.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section, navigation buttons, and feature highlights for reading and sharing stories.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login interface using Internet Identity with handling for authenticated, logging-in, and error states.
frontend/src/pages/MySubmissionsPage.tsx: Empty page placeholder for displaying the user's submitted stories.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Displays a full story with metadata, handles loading/error states, and includes comment composer and thread.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Form for authenticated users to submit stories with anonymous option and submission confirmation flow.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: Troubleshooting guide for canister ID resolution issues with copyable canister info and explanatory alerts.
frontend/src/utils/authErrors.ts: Utility functions for detecting unauthorized errors and extracting error messages.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Generates frontend and backend canister IDs from hostname or environment and builds standard and raw access URLs for troubleshooting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and manage hash-based query values.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes project state and features for replacing the My Submissions area with a login page, including requirements and pending requests.
